description: Source-specific OneHousing monthly apartment popular asking price. Isolated from Batdongsan overall listing-price trends and from individual Rever/CafeLand asking ads. Initial 2026-10 record is the already-reviewed baseline, not a new observation.

evidence.period: Căn hộ chung cư dự án Vinhomes Grand Park tháng 10/2026

data.methodology_note: OneHousing's modal/popular apartment asking rate (54.47 million VND/m²) and exceptionally broad apartment asking range are different statistics. Neither is a weighted project ASP or transaction price. Source's 0% change indicator is not a second independent observation. Do not combine with Batdongsan's methodology.
